##: Release workflow replaces version, architecture.64bit.url, and architecture.64bit.hash before publishing this manifest to jag-k/scoop-bucket.
The published bucket manifest always points to the latest stable release; autoupdate describes how the next concrete manifest revision is generated.
Scoop runs uninstall hooks during updates too; old_version is present in that path and prevents removal of the user's autostart preference.
description: Rule-based clipboard transformer with a tray app and command-line interface
post_uninstall: if ($null -eq $old_version) { Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'dev.jag-k.clipboard-transformer' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\StartupApproved\Run' -Name 'dev.jag-k.clipboard-transformer' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Clipboard Transformer') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
notes: The clipboard-transformer CLI is available on PATH through Scoop's shim.
The Start Menu shortcut launches the Clipboard Transformer tray app.
Run on Startup is controlled from the tray menu, preserved across Scoop upgrades, and removed on uninstall.
Configuration, state, and cache are stored outside the Scoop installation and are preserved during upgrades and uninstall.
